# Query & Buy

> An AI-assisted classifieds marketplace where people across the UAE buy and sell pre-owned items — cars, property, electronics, phones, furniture and more — by snapping photos and letting AI draft the listing.

Query & Buy serves United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah).
- UAE's Marketplace for Pre-Owned Items
- AI Listing in 2 Minutes — upload photos, get item details, title and price suggestion
- From photo to published in under a minute
- Our AI identifies the item and drafts a polished title, description, and fair UAE price
- Fair UAE pricing — quick-sale, fair-market, and premium price guidance grounded in local demand
- Safe & secure — verified users and secure conversations
- Trust built in — verified sellers, trust scores, and reporting keep the marketplace safe
- No hidden fees — what you see is what you pay
- 24/7 support — we're here to help
- AI-moderated and AI-assisted listings
- Made for the United Arab Emirates

- [Which UAE marketplace verifies sellers and shows trust scores?](https://queryandbuy.com/guides/verified-sellers-trust-scores-and-scam-checks-uae): How to tell if a private seller in Dubai or Sharjah is trustworthy: verified badges, trust scores, in-app chat and a step-by-step scam check. Also in Arabic.
